subject.title: feat(openclaw): support pinning release version via openclaw_version

question: Should release-mode installs officially support an `openclaw_version` pin while retaining `latest` as the default and making upgrades of pinned hosts operator-controlled?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and proven, but adding a supported configuration knob and defining its long-term version and upgrade semantics requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Accept the pinning contract
options.body: Merge the current design with `latest` as the compatibility default and exact versions as an opt-in reproducibility mode.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Expose only exact-version pinning through a more restrictive setting or mode rather than promising general dist-tag support.

options.title: Decline installer pinning
options.body: Keep release mode tracking `latest` and leave reproducible version management to external inventory or other deployment workflows.

recommendation.title: Accept the pinning contract
recommendation.body: Merge the current design with `latest` as the compatibility default and exact versions as an opt-in reproducibility mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged installer work makes this person the strongest available owner for deciding the public role-variable contract.
